summary: Feed s073_single to APM is degraded due to 7.7% duplicate packets (178/2308) exceeding 5% threshold. All other visibility checks (one-way, drops, overload, truncation, tunnels, VLAN, encryption, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Duplicate packets indicate the same traffic is being delivered twice, most commonly from SPAN/mirror aggregation or dual TAP feeds merged without deduplication on the packet broker. 7.7% duplicates exceeds the 5% healthy threshold.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM wastes CPU/storage processing the same packet twice, inflates flow/transaction counts and can skew latency and error-rate calculations, reducing detection accuracy and capacity headroom.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication to drop identical packets seen within a short time window before delivery to the APM, eliminating double-counting while preserving complete bidirectional visibility.
